note: grok-cli documents GROK_BASE_URL (default https://api.x.ai/v1), so the /v1 is part of the value. The fetch hook goes in as well because grok-cli runs on Bun with sub-agents on by default, and api.x.ai is not one of the hook default hosts — hence ORCA_INSTRUMENT_HOSTS. BUN_OPTIONS carries --preload because Bun ignores --require inside NODE_OPTIONS. Its Telegram remote control is the same process reading the same variable. harness_versions is null: the adapter is written from the published README, not pinned to a release.
